Agent API Models
Compare Agent API models, token pricing, supported service tiers, and provider documentation.
[!NOTE]
Looking for ranked web results instead of a generated answer? Use the Search API at POST /search. It takes no model parameter and bills per successful request, not per token. Start with the Search API quickstart (https://docs.perplexity.ai/docs/search/quickstart.md).
Available Models
The Agent API provides a unified interface to models from multiple providers with transparent token-based pricing.
Pricing rates are published per model and may differ from provider list prices. All charges are based on actual token consumption, and every API response includes exact token counts so you know your costs per request.
The Service tiers column lists optional non-default tiers. An em dash means the model uses default processing only.
A rate with a context-length range, such as (≤272k), changes when the input is above that range. A single value applies at every context length.
[!TIP]
Looking for pre-configured model setups? See Effort Levels (https://docs.perplexity.ai/docs/agent-api/effort.md) — optimized for specific use cases.
[tab] Anthropic
[card] Anthropic

[!WARNING]
Requests that use an anthropic/* model must include max_output_tokens. If omitted, the API returns HTTP 400 with validation failed: max_output_tokens is required when using Anthropic models. max_output_tokens is a shared Agent API parameter, but this required condition applies only to Anthropic models.

[tab] Perplexity

Perplexity's grounded search model.
Service tiers
Omit service_tier, or set it to auto or default, to use default processing. flex uses lower-cost, best-effort capacity at 0.5× the listed token prices. priority uses higher-priority processing at 2× the listed token prices. fast is accepted as an alias for priority. These multipliers apply only to models that list the tier in the Service tiers column. Other models always bill at the listed rate.
When you provide model or models, the Agent API applies flex or priority only if the selected model—or every model in a fallback list—supports that tier. An unsupported tier does not cause the request to be rejected; the API ignores service_tier and uses default processing. Requests that specify only an effort level or profile retain the tier until the model is resolved. The response's service_tier field reports the tier that served the request.
[!WARNING]
Not all third-party models support all features (e.g., reasoning, tools). Check model documentation for specific capabilities.

Documentation Index
Fetch the complete documentation index at: https://docs.perplexity.ai/llms.txt
Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.
Pricing
Understand Perplexity API pricing, model rates, request fees, billing setup, and rate-limit references.
Each Perplexity API bills differently. The rates are in the sections below.
* Orchestrator API: per token, at each model's rates. No per-request fees. Requests rejected with a 429 are not billed.
* Agent API: per token, at each model's rates, plus tool fees. Most tools bill per call; sandbox bills per session, plus each SDK search query made inside it. The flex (0.5×) and priority (2×) service tiers change the token rates only for models that list that tier on the Agent API Models page (https://docs.perplexity.ai/docs/agent-api/models.md). Other models always bill at the listed rate.
* Search API: per successful request.
* Embeddings API: per token.
* Decisions API: per input token. Output tokens are free. With mode: "web_grounding", each web search adds $0.001.
For billing setup, payment methods, and usage monitoring, see the Admin section (https://docs.perplexity.ai/docs/getting-started/projects.md). For rate limits, see Rate Limits & Usage Tiers (https://docs.perplexity.ai/docs/admin/rate-limits-usage-tiers.md).
Orchestrator API Pricing
Orchestrator API usage is billed per token at each model's published rates — there are no per-request fees. Every model has its own input and output rate, with cache reads billed at the model's discounted cache-read rate and reasoning tokens billed at the output rate. You are always billed at the requested model's rates, regardless of how the request is served.
See Orchestrator Models & Pricing (https://docs.perplexity.ai/docs/router/models.md) for the full per-model rate card, including cache-read rates.
Agent API Pricing
The Agent API provides access to third-party models from providers including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, xAI, Z.AI, Moonshot AI, and NVIDIA with transparent, token-based pricing at each model's published rates.
Model Pricing
Agent API pricing varies by provider and model, with each provider offering multiple models at different price points.
The input, output, and cache-read rate for each model is on the Agent API Models page (https://docs.perplexity.ai/docs/agent-api/models.md).
Tool Pricing
When using tools with the Agent API:
[!NOTE]
Most tool costs are per invocation. sandbox is billed per container session — a 20-minute billing window per container, not a runtime cap — plus per SDK search query made from inside it. Tool costs are separate from model token costs.
Search API Pricing
[!NOTE]
Billing unit: Search API charges for each successful POST /search request, not for each query in the request. A successful request containing an array of up to five queries is one billing unit. Invalid requests, rate-limited requests, and upstream failures are not billed. A successful response is billed even when it returns no results. There are no additional token-based charges.
Search API cost = successful requests ÷ 1,000 × the price per 1K requests. The amount of extracted text (max_tokens, max_tokens_per_page) does not change the price.
What a result contains, the request controls, and the limits on queries, results, and extracted text are in the Search API overview (https://docs.perplexity.ai/docs/search/overview.md).
Embeddings API Pricing
Generate high-quality text embeddings for semantic search, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and other machine learning applications.
Standard Embeddings
Contextualized Embeddings
Embeddings cost = tokens ÷ 1,000,000 × the model's rate. For example, 40M tokens on pplx-embed-context-v1-4b cost 40 × $0.05 = $2.00.
To use the Embeddings API, see the Embeddings quickstart (https://docs.perplexity.ai/docs/embeddings/quickstart.md).
Decisions API Pricing
The Decisions API answers yes/no, multiple-choice, and scored questions about text and images with calibrated probabilities.
[!NOTE]
Aliases: pplx-decider-latest and perplexity/pplx-decider-latest select pplx-decider-v1.2. pplx-decider-flash-latest and perplexity/pplx-decider-flash-latest select pplx-decider-flash-v1.2. An alias bills at the rate of the model it selects. Requests that name pplx-decider-v1.1-27b or pplx-decider-v1-27b select pplx-decider-v1.2 and bill at $0.02.
Billing unit: you pay for input tokens, plus web searches and URL fetches if you set mode: "web_grounding". The state, every question, any images, fetched page text, and any search results added to the state count as input; the response reports the exact number as usage.input_tokens, so you can compute the token cost of a request from the response you already receive. A request with 600 input tokens costs $0.000012 on pplx-decider-v1.2 and $0.000006 on pplx-decider-flash-v1.2.
Web grounding
A request with mode: "web_grounding" runs one Fast Search (https://docs.perplexity.ai/docs/search/fast-search.md) for each of its questions, up to 100, before the model answers. Each search costs $0.001 ($1 per 1,000), in addition to input tokens, so at most $0.10 in searches per request. Questions that produce the same search query share one search.
When state is a page URL, the API also fetches the page before searching. Each successful URL fetch costs $0.001; a failed fetch is not billed. One successful fetch and three successful searches cost $0.004, plus input tokens.
* Billed: every search that returns, even with no results. Completed searches and successful URL fetches remain billable if the request later fails, for example because the input exceeds the token limit.
* Not billed: a search that fails or runs out of time, a question with no text to search, and requests rejected before search: an invalid mode, more than 100 questions, a missing or unknown model, or a state that is not a string, object, or array. A request can be billed for fewer searches than it has questions.
* Input tokens: fetched page text and search evidence are billed as input tokens and included in usage.input_tokens.
See Web grounding (https://docs.perplexity.ai/docs/decisions/quickstart.md#web-grounding).
To use the Decisions API, see the Decisions quickstart (https://docs.perplexity.ai/docs/decisions/quickstart.md).
Token counts: 1 token is about 4 characters of English text. The exact count varies with language and content.
Cost Examples
To estimate an Agent API request, add these parts:
* uncached input tokens × the model's input rate ÷ 1,000,000
* cached input tokens × the model's cache-read rate ÷ 1,000,000
* output tokens × the model's output rate ÷ 1,000,000. The response reports reasoning tokens in usage.output_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens; the Models page notes where they bill at the output rate.
* the price of each tool call (from the Tool Pricing table)
* $0.03 per sandbox session, plus $0.0025 per SDK search query made inside it
Model rates are per 1M tokens, on the Agent API Models page (https://docs.perplexity.ai/docs/agent-api/models.md). Where a rate lists a context-length range, use the rate that matches the request's input size. With flex or priority on a model that lists that tier, multiply the token cost by 0.5 or 2. Tool fees don't change.
Actual effort level costs vary with the selected model, token usage, and tool invocations. When present on a completed response, usage.cost.total_cost reports the calculated request cost.
Purchase Options
* Perplexity API Platform on AWS Marketplace (https://docs.perplexity.ai/docs/resources/aws-marketplace.md): buy API credits through AWS Marketplace with consolidated billing and enterprise procurement.
* Contact the sales team (https://perplexity.typeform.com/to/m3WnMaG6): ask about custom pricing, dedicated support, and enterprise features.

Documentation Index

Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further.
Orchestrator Models & Pricing
The model catalog for the Perplexity Orchestrator API, with per-token pricing for Perplexity-hosted and third-party models.
[!NOTE]
Orchestrator API is in private preview. Email api@perplexity.ai (mailto:api@perplexity.ai) to request access.
Overview
Every model below is available through both Orchestrator API endpoints — Chat Completions (https://docs.perplexity.ai/api-reference/gateway-chat-completions-post.md) and Messages (https://docs.perplexity.ai/api-reference/gateway-messages-post.md) — under the same creator/model-name id. Prices are in USD per 1 million tokens, and you are billed at the requested model's rates regardless of how the request is served.
For the live catalog, query GET /models (https://docs.perplexity.ai/api-reference/gateway-models-get); the tables below show the current catalog.
[!NOTE]
Cached input is billed separately from fresh input: cache reads are billed at the discounted per-model rate shown in the "Cache read" column, and cache writes at the rate shown (or at the input rate where no dedicated write rate is listed). Reasoning tokens are billed at the output rate.
perplexity/glm-5.3-flash supports cache reads but not cache writes.
Perplexity-Hosted Models
Open-source models hosted by Perplexity — the perplexity/ prefix reflects who serves the model, not who created it. The catalog includes models from DeepSeek, Moonshot AI, and Z.AI:
Listing Models Programmatically
The response lists every available model sorted by id, including each model's base token prices. Requesting a model that is not in the catalog returns a 400 naming the invalid model — the catalog is also the allowlist.

https://docs.perplexity.ai/docs/getting-started/pricing.md: Aliases: pplx-decider-latest and perplexity/pplx-decider-latest select pplx-decider-v1.2. pplx-decider-flash-latest and perplexity/pplx-decider-flash-latest select pplx-decider-flash-v1.2. An alias bills at the rate of the model it selects. Requests that name pplx-decider-v1.1-27b or pplx-decider-v1-27b select pplx-decider-v1.2 and bill at $0.02.

https://docs.perplexity.ai/docs/getting-started/pricing.md: Billing unit: Search API charges for each successful POST /search request, not for each query in the request. A successful request containing an array of up to five queries is one billing unit. Invalid requests, rate-limited requests, and upstream failures are not billed. A successful response is billed even when it returns no results. There are no additional token-based charges.

https://docs.perplexity.ai/docs/getting-started/pricing.md: Billing unit: you pay for input tokens, plus web searches and URL fetches if you set mode: "web_grounding". The state, every question, any images, fetched page text, and any search results added to the state count as input; the response reports the exact number as usage.input_tokens, so you can compute the token cost of a request from the response you already receive. A request with 600 input tokens costs $0.000012 on pplx-decider-v1.2 and $0.000006 on pplx-decider-flash-v1.2.

https://docs.perplexity.ai/docs/getting-started/pricing.md: Orchestrator API usage is billed per token at each model's published rates — there are no per-request fees. Every model has its own input and output rate, with cache reads billed at the model's discounted cache-read rate and reasoning tokens billed at the output rate. You are always billed at the requested model's rates, regardless of how the request is served.
